<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Economic growth discourse:</strong> Prime Minister Modi hailed India&#x27;s 7.8% GDP growth as a &quot;herculean feat,&quot; though the Congress party criticized the figures, questioning the state of employment and data accuracy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial interventions:</strong> The Supreme Court dismissed a plea for mandatory ethanol content disclosure in petrol and criticized the Andhra Pradesh SIT for delays in a two-year liquor investigation.</li>
